verdicts.reason: A has a clear left-to-right banner structure with the headline and subcopy vertically centred and the CTA on the right, but the phone runs almost the full canvas height and nearly touches the top and bottom edges. The tilted 'ONLINE ONLY' badge, stacked under 'Try It' at nearly the same width, reads as a second button and weakens the CTA. B gives the CTA strong prominence and keeps the original badge-beside-button pairing, but the headline is jammed near the top edge. The badge and button cluster in the bottom-right while the space under the subcopy sits empty, and the phone and circle crowd the top-left, so the whole layout feels cramped and top-heavy.
